DRAFT-ESSAY.text:
Schools should require uniforms because they make students equal. Uniforms cost money, families can buy them once and reuse them. One study found that uniforms improve grades (Hallow and Reyes 2019 p. 12). Everyone knows uniforms reduce bullying.

Some students say uniforms limit expression, this argument ignores that students express themselves in many other ways. Walking into school, the uniforms make everyone look the same. The rule would effect every student the same.

Uniforms make students equal, that is why schools should require them.

DRAFT-RUNON.about: DRAFT-RUNON · twelve run-on sentences (written by TUTOR-B for C11; the kit listed it as still to do)
DRAFT-RUNON.text: The oven was hot, the bread was ready, nobody came. Tomas wiped the counter, he checked the clock, it was early still. The bell rang, a stranger came in, he wanted rye. Flour covered the floor, Tomas swept it, more fell. The stranger paid, he left, the door stayed open. Rain started, the street went dark, Tomas lit a lamp. A dog wandered in, it sniffed the crates, it left again. Tomas counted the loaves, he counted twice, the number was wrong. The phone buzzed, he ignored it, it buzzed again. He sat on a crate, the oven ticked, the room smelled of rye. Someone knocked at the back, Tomas froze, the knock came again. He opened the door, the alley was empty, a paper bag sat on the step.
